points.description: Gives the center of the ellipse as (-4, 1). The student must complete the square in both x and y (or use an equivalent valid method) with every step mathematically valid, reaching the standard form (x+4)^2/36 + (y-1)^2/81 = 1 or an equivalent form from which the center is read off. Equivalent wording and alternative correct methods earn the mark. Any invalid step, or a wrong final center, earns no mark.

rubric.notes: Full mark requires a fully valid derivation and the correct center (-4, 1). Any algebraic error or an incorrect final centre earns zero, as the model answer specifies, so there is no partial credit.
